capabilities._note: Alibaba's Qwen3-TTS 1.7B (Apache 2.0) through flybirdxx's ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS. Sent the words alone. With no sample, VoiceDesign makes the voice from the character's description (its design's first sentence and the series config's `voice` line, as instruct); with one, the Base model clones it: the sample cut between words to 5-20 s (reference_clip), with its words when seriesmith knows them (reference_text: the line its take was asked to say, or a recording's timings), else from the voice alone (x_vector_only, which Qwen says clones less closely). Its length is the line's. On transformers 5.21 or later the pack's cloning needs flybirdxx/ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS#115 (the Mimi encoder). Tried live 2026-11-07 (RTX 5090, transformers 5.22 with #115): in the pack's Multi-role Dialogue on Ballroom ep03's Charming and Ava samples, every word of five lines heard by Whisper, each line's median pitch within 1-11 Hz of its sample's; through `seriesmith refs --voices`, Charming cloned with his sample's words (119 Hz against 122), Harrow cloned and Smith designed from his description, words right, 8-17 s a take.

template._note: The model decides the length (it ends at end of speech): these only bound what a sample is asked to say.

recipe._note: The words alone (targets/audio/common.py words_line / words_prompt). The description goes to VoiceDesign's own instruct, never into the words (target.py).

binding._note: Qwen3-TTS Voice Design and SaveAudio, as the pack's nodes take them (1.7B, bf16, attention auto, the model unloaded after each take: the pack keeps its own cache outside ComfyUI's memory management, which would otherwise hold VRAM a video render needs). With a sample, target.py puts Voice Clone in Voice Design's place, reading it through LoadAudio. H3SaveRefAudio takes SaveAudio's place.

nodes._note: Beyond the workflow's own classes: what a clone adds (target.py). The pack's Voice Clone, and ComfyUI's LoadAudio.

fetches._note: The pack reads a model from the folder under models/qwen-tts whose name has its size and kind (Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base), and downloads what's missing by itself when a job runs, the tokenizer included: the Features window downloads them there instead (`dir`), and the target isn't ready without them. Not under models/qwen-tts/Qwen/, as the pack's README draws it: the pack doesn't look there.
